_not: Sefer hikâye sahneleri, Harita 1 final sinematiği ve Harita 3 kapanış sineması (first_fire_mend / first_fire_quench: trigger on mapComplete + map + crownChoice = harita bitti ve Mend or Quench seçimi bu; title = başlık (yoksa tetik düğümünün / haritanın adı); credits = bitince jenerik (data/credits.json); Ömer 2026-11-21 form r38-r39) (oyun içi metin İngilizce; Ömer kararları 2026-10-21, form CprM9eeoVef4RYd2VH52Ro; not: docs/design/campaign/cinematics.md). Her anahtar bir sinematik: trigger = nerede tetiklenir (src/campaign/cinematics.ts > dueCinematic okur; görüldü bilgisi kayıtta done listesinde cinematic:<id>, seferde bir kez; oynatıcı src/ui/cinematic.ts), scenes[] = sırayla gösterilen sahneler; her sahnede bg = arka plan anahtarı (border-road / kings-bridge / ember-road / castle-hall var olan savaş arka planları; cin_* = final sinematiğinin yeni görselleri/klipleri, henüz yok), lines[] = oyuncu dokundukça satır satır ilerleyen satırlar. speaker: narrator (anlatıcı), leader (bölük lideri; adı yok, oyunda sınıf adıyla görünür), ya da portre anahtarı (bridge_warden, lord_morvane = boss id + assets/avatars; merchant = Odo, portresi assets/avatars/merchant). Seçenek / likes YOK. endCard = son kapanış kartı (campaign.json > texts.complete ile aynı metin). Hafif ipucu kuralı: Morvane sırrı açmaz; yalnızca tacın kırılmaması ve korlarının parlaması sezdirilir.

_fallback._not: Eksik sahne görselinin yedeği (arka plan anahtarı -> başka anahtar). Görsel aranma sırası: assets/cinematics/<bg>.webp, sonra assets/backgrounds/<bg>.webp, ikisi de yoksa buradaki yedek (zincir izlenir). Yeni görsel gelince yalnızca dosya eklenir, kod değişmez.

_speakers._not: Konuşan anahtarı -> görünen ad + portre (assets/avatars/<portrait>.webp). Burada olmayan anahtar: narrator = portresiz, adsız; leader = bölük liderinin sınıf adı + sınıf avatarı; diğerleri boss / mob id (görünen adı ve avatarı oyun verisinden).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For a year now, grey ash has fallen over Valdoria.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It drifts south from Castle Morvane in the north, and each day the Ash Curse swallows a little more of the land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fields wither, the dead stir in their graves, and men in ash masks sing praise to the Ash Lord.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your road begins on Mill Road, on the western coast. It ends at Morvane's gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last chain snaps. The Bridge Warden sinks to the stones, and the ember in its chest burns low.

lines.speaker: bridge_warden
lines.text: None shall cross... until the king returns. Has he come? Has the king come home?

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: No one is coming. Your watch is over, Warden.

lines.speaker: bridge_warden
lines.text: Over... Then go north. The Ember in me always leaned toward the crown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its light goes out. What is left of King's Bridge still holds, and the road north lies open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Below the heights, a few tents huddle around one stubborn fire. A familiar cart stands beside it.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Still breathing, friend? Good. The dead make poor customers.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Deserters came down from the gate last week. They swear the halls are thick with ash, and Morvane's crown never stops burning.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: Then we will need your best, Odo.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Last stall before the castle, so the prices are honest. Well, honest enough.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ash drifts through the great hall like snow. Beneath a crown of burning iron, Lord Morvane rises from his throne.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: You have come a long way through the ash to reach my hall. Few walk so far only to die.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: We came to end the Ash Curse.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: Everything in Valdoria kneels to the ash in the end. So will you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last blow lands. Lord Morvane sinks to one knee, and the ash in the hall hangs still.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: So it ends with strangers. I always thought it would.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: Your curse ends with you, Morvane.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lord Morvane falls silent. The Crown of Ash rolls across the stones. It does not break. Its embers still glow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across Valdoria the grey ash stops falling. For the first time in a year, the wind smells of rain.

morvane_falls.endCard: The Ash Curse is broken. Valdoria is free again. Ash settles over the roads, and the villages light their hearths once more. In the vault beneath Castle Morvane the crown lies unbroken, its embers still glowing.

first_fire_mend.title: The Crownbearer

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The hall of the First Hearth falls quiet. For a long while no one in the company moves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The climb back takes days. At Kharduin's gate the dwarves wait with lanterns, and they do not ask what you found below.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: It is done. Keep your lanterns lit for the ones who stayed below.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Down through the Windwall and the Snowline, past Morvane's burnt keep, the company walks south toward Mill Road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The crown rests warm on your leader's brow. In every village the hearths burn brighter, and no one yet knows what the fire will ask in return.

first_fire_mend.endCard: The fire beneath the mountain has had its answer. The long road from Mill Road to the First Hearth is walked to its end.

first_fire_quench.title: The Dark Hearth

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The hall of the First Hearth falls quiet. For a long while no one in the company moves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The climb back takes days. At Kharduin's gate the dwarves wait with lanterns, and they do not ask what you found below.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: It is done. Keep your lanterns lit for the ones who stayed below.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Down through the Windwall and the Snowline, past Morvane's burnt keep, the company walks south toward Mill Road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No crown waits for Valdoria now, only the long road home and the rain. For good or ill, the land belongs to no fire.

first_fire_quench.endCard: The fire beneath the mountain has had its answer. The long road from Mill Road to the First Hearth is walked to its end.
